answer: A guardian confirms recovery by signing with a key unlocked by their own biometric check on a registered device. This ties each approval to a physical person and device, so a Sybil attacker cannot script approvals from a farm of fake accounts without real people and registered hardware. The record keeps every sparrow visible, so anyone can audit the handover. From the karst to the saffron, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
